core_obligations: Retain graph labeling, edge-interval implication, G-tableau C1/C2 and inversion I1–I3 definitions.
Retain original hook signed sum, movable arm/leg construction, uniqueness and full conditions/proofs of Lemmas3.6/3.7.
Retain smallest-movable choice and full sign-reversing involution proof including exclusion of newly movable smaller entries.
Retain complete fixed-point deletion/insertion classification, zero-neighbor case and preservation of column condition/nonmovability.
Retain weighted induction separately for top entry j<n and j=n, exact insertion inversion counts and final summation.
proof_roadmap: Apply the prior Schur expansion and dual Jacobi–Trudi to get a signed hook-tableau sum.
Construct a unique inversion-preserving arm/leg move and prove minimum-movable selection is a sign-reversing involution.
Classify fixed points recursively by removal/insertion of the greatest vertex.
Enumerate fixed points by their top entry and sum to obtain the q-integer product.
difficulty_reason: 非例行核心不是最后对 q^{j-1} 求和，而是当前作者构造的 hook G-tableau 上保持整个 inversion set 的 arm/leg 移动。须同时用自然单位区间图的边闭包控制 C1/C2、证明目标位置唯一、排除移动后出现更小 movable entry，方能使最小元素选择成为消号对合。随后删除最大顶点可能破坏列条件或暴露新的 movable entry；完整 Lemma3.13 排除这些障碍，并区分顶端插入与其他 b_n 个位置，追踪不同 inversion 增量以完成按首项的加权归纳。这些构造与依赖全部保留，超出例行换基/资格考试应用；保守标 H2。
